title: Traffic-light town · Level 1: Main Street
brief: The colour robot starts in a 300 x 300 mm start box at the west end of Main Street, a white street 300 mm wide and 2400 mm long (starts vary 10 mm and 2 degrees); the level fixes the robot. Two traffic lights, 150 x 300 mm patches across the street with their middles 800 mm and 1600 mm from the street's start, are painted red or green, changing every 4 s, each starting at a moment new every run. The school, a blue 300 x 300 mm zone, is at the street's east end. A run ends once the program has ended and the robot has then stood still for 0.5 s, or at 60 s. A robot whose colour sensor leaves a light on the far side while it is red has run a red light: that run scores 0. A run finishes when the robot stops with its middle in the school, having driven through every light, without running a red light. Per run: 50 for finishing, plus up to 40 for speed on the driving time (the run's time less the time the robot stood still; all 40 at 18 s or less, 40 x 18 / driving time above it), both paid only on a finish; plus 10 if at every stop on a red light the colour sensor was short of the light's middle line. Pass: mean 60 or more over 5 runs, 4 of them finished. Par time: 18 s.

score.run: round(if(redRun, 0, if(stopped & inSchool & lightsCrossed == 2, 50 + 40 * min(1, par / max(driveS, 0.001)), 0) + if(redStopPast == 0, 10, 0)), 1)
score.summary: round(sum(r in runs: r.points) / count(r in runs: true), 1)

finished.value: count(r in runs: r.stopped & r.inSchool & !r.redRun & r.lightsCrossed == 2)
